title: Home Range and Movements of the Eastern Cottontail in Kansas

This study focuses on understanding the home range and movement patterns of the Eastern Cottontail rabbit ("Sylvilagus floridanus") in northeastern Kansas. The book presents the findings of Janes' research conducted over a 90-acre area at the University of Kansas Natural History Reservation.
